notes: Yellow fascia and long banner of The Captain's Bakery and Grill (Jamaica); the striped dome-topped pole hides the end of the upper fascia ('and Gr...') and part of the second banner logo ('CAPTAI...'). 'the' is in small script above CAPTAIN'S. Distractors: red 'NO ...KING' sign at lower left, cut-off teal billboard at right ('Your Mo... / SHOP T... / ACT... Home ... / KINGSTON | MONTE...'), small neon 'Donuts' in the window. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.

author: CaptJayRuffins
attribution: Photo: CaptJayRuffins, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Claude_Stuart_Park_sign_20231007_120834.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Jamaica National Heritage Trust heritage-trail marker in Port Maria, St. Mary: name panel on top, long history text panel below (small text, not transcribed; mentions Victoria Park, Sir Charles Price, Tacky and Wycliffe Martin monuments, declared a National Monument on May 2, 1996). JNHT and TPDCo logos in the corners. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.

author: wardyboy400
attribution: Photo: wardyboy400, CC BY 2.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Ricks_Cafe_Sign_(8489045629).jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Round red-yellow-green smiley sign with cut-out letters under a thatched gable at Rick's Café, Negril; 'THANKS' arcs around the top. The sign spells RICKS without an apostrophe; it is a farewell sign, so the business name is the only searchable part.
